page.overview:
Who is Somnambula?

Somnambula (, sahm-NAM-byoo-luh) is a female Pegasus and figure of Equestrian legend first mentioned in season six's The Crystalling - Part 2. She makes her first appearance in the IDW comics' and her first in-show appearance in the season seven episode Daring Done?

Somnambula shares her name with a G1 villain, a human witch, from the two-part My Little Pony n' Friends episode of the same name.

The name "Somnambula" is derived from the word "somnambulism", another word for sleepwalking.

Somnambula is first mentioned in The Crystalling - Part 2 by Sunburst as the subject of a spell called "Somnambula's Weather Abjuration". She is later mentioned in Celestial Advice by Starlight Glimmer as the subject of "Somnambula's Tempus Objectus".
